parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck are internally consistent and show a plausible ATtiny fan-controller design: regulated 5 V, high-side P-FET fan power switching, tach clamp/pull-up, PWM output, ISP and I2C headers, and standard passive values. The presence of two pin-compatible ATtiny footprints (DIP and SOIC) tied to the same nets can reasonably be an intentional multi-footprint/compatibility design, so the files do not support a definite anomaly.
